focus: Fixes for build 10's review: UseGenericEnterMapFloatMenuOption, mapless site cleanup in CanEnterAt, carried item before ExitMap, MoveArrivedOut on map removal, 'going' passed to Enter
diffSource: since build 10 (2026-10-07T03:51:01Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Thin rock roof lets transport pods and shuttles land inside the dungeon, skipping the party checks
findings.detail: GenStep_DungeonPlaceholder now roofs with RoofRockThin. DropCellFinder.CanPhysicallyDropInto only rejects thick roofs, and TargetingParameters.ForDropPodsDestination calls it with canRoofPunch:true. MapParent.GetTransportersFloatMenuOptions (and GetShuttleFloatMenuOptions) still offer 'Land in existing map' on DungeonSite. Under thick roof no cell accepted a pod; now a pod can drop pawns into a running dungeon past the party cap and the already-entered rule. That is the same hole the UseGenericEnterMapFloatMenuOption=false override was added to close. One change: override GetTransportersFloatMenuOptions in DungeonSite to yield nothing (and GetShuttleFloatMenuOptions the same way).

findings.title: Thin rock roof can collapse in room centres that thick roof never could
findings.detail: Rooms are up to 14x14, so centre cells are more than 6.9 cells from any wall. The walls cannot be broken, so nothing knocks them down, but if the player removes roof, JobDriver_RemoveRoof runs RoofCollapseCellsFinder.CheckCollapseFlyingRoofs, and thin roof (unlike thick) can then fall on pawns. Not reachable without player action.

findings.title: The leftover-site cleanup in CanEnterAt runs while menus and gizmos are built, so one menu shows both options
findings.detail: Vanilla FloatMenuMakerWorld.ChoicesAtFor asks the leftover DungeonSite for its options (the disabled 'party inside' entry) before the mod's postfix runs CanEnterAt, which destroys the site and then adds a working Enter. That first menu shows both. Cosmetic and one-time. World ticks run from a copied list (WorldObjectsHolderTick), so destroying the site from StillValid is safe.

checked: UseGenericEnterMapFloatMenuOption is protected virtual on MapParent and is checked in MapParent.GetFloatMenuOptions, so the override disables vanilla Enter (MapParent.cs:27, 238)
TryMovePawnOut: Pawn.ExitMap destroys a carried thing that is not a pawn, so moving it to inventory first is correct; carried pawns are left to Caravan.AddPawn and ExitMap
Notify_MyMapAboutToBeRemoved runs before MapDeiniter.Deinit (Game.DeinitAndRemoveMap), so ExitMap in MoveArrivedOut runs on a live map; the list of exits is not changed while it is looped over
MoveArrivedOut calling Notify_PawnLeft cannot hide the party-lost letter when all humans died: with no waiting caravan, animals cannot leave
Dialog_EnterDungeon passes going.ToList(), so Enter no longer depends on a list it empties; when everyone goes in, Enter reaches the same everyone/split decision as the dialog
CanEnterAt destroying a site: WorldObject.Destroy removes it from the holder; world objects tick from a copied list
Dialog_DungeonFinder: WorldInfo.persistentRandomValue exists and is saved; old-game pawns kept when the same save is reloaded are dropped by the RemoveWhere in the constructor
DungeonSettings clamp 5000-300000 matches the settings slider range in Mod.cs:87
TUBAD_Enter_Everyone text matches Enter's everyone branch (unticked items go to the stash)
pyxis_mod_errors not run: no Pyxis token is configured (Settings → Integrations)
